decisions.summary: Pacific Star Shipping changes the reefer container free time to 5 days effective 1 July 2026.
Jiwoo Han hands over ownership of the SOP-03 free-time table to Daniel Cho going forward, as Jiwoo is leaving on 30 June.

tasks.summary: Update the Pacific Star reefer line in the SOP-03 free-time table to show the new 5-day free time and the 1 July 2026 start date.
